prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Report Builder', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'ANZ', 'symptoms_observed': ['timeout'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 108, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Report Builder Timing Out on Large Exports", "description": "We are experiencing consistent timeouts when attempting to generate or export reports via Report Builder in our production environment (ANZ region). Since this morning, any attempt to run reports with large datasets is failing after a short period, returning a timeout error to the user. Currently, about 108 users within our sales and operations teams are blocked from accessing these reports, which is severely impacting our daily reporting capabilities and business operations. We have confirmed the issue is not isolated to specific users or browsers, suggesting a platform-wide issue. Please investigate urgently as we have critical deadlines approaching."}]}
